name: DeepSeek API
description: One DeepSeek API key gives Finch web search, page reading as Markdown, and PDF/Office/image OCR.
systemPrompt: When the user needs web search with sources, a specific URL read as Markdown, or OCR of a PDF/Word/PowerPoint file or image, use the deepseek_api tool; if it reports that no API key is configured, call setup_deepseek_api to collect one securely.

setup-deepseek.title: Set up DeepSeek API
setup-deepseek.prompt: Set up the DeepSeek API tools for Finch.

read-a-link.title: Read a link
read-a-link.description: Turn a web page into Markdown.

ocr-a-file.title: OCR a file
ocr-a-file.description: Extract text from a PDF or image.
ocr-a-file.prompt: OCR this file and give me the text:

settings.status.label: Status
settings.configure.hover: Search, page reading and OCR share this single key.
settings.clear.hover: Delete the stored key from this device.
settings.clearDialog.title: Remove DeepSeek API key
settings.clearDialog.message: The stored key will be deleted from this device. Search, page reading and OCR stop working until you add one again.
settings.dialog.title: DeepSeek API key
settings.dialog.message: One key unlocks web search, page reading and OCR. Get it at https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys
form.setup.title: Connect DeepSeek API
form.setup.description: Enter your DeepSeek API key. It is stored in system secure storage and never returned to the model.
toast.saved.title: DeepSeek API connected
toast.saved.description: Search, page reading and OCR are ready.
toast.cleared.title: API key removed
toast.cleared.description: DeepSeek tools are unavailable until you add a key again.
setup.noKey: No DeepSeek API key was provided; nothing was saved.

setup.unverified: DeepSeek API key saved, but the balance check failed: {message}. The key may still work.
